params.body:
The `Soort` field on an event (live music, quiz, card night, theme night, other) was asked in the Studio but never used by the site: no page reads `kind`. It was one more field for the owner to fill in for nothing.

- Removed the field from the `event` schema.
- Removed `kind` from the event queries and the `EventDoc` type.

No document in the dataset has a value for `kind` (`count(*[defined(kind)])` is 0), so nothing is lost and the Studio shows no unknown-field warning.

Checked: `astro build` against the live dataset and `tsc --noEmit`, both clean.
params.title: Drop the event kind field
